findings.principle: Water Room Beside the Cooking Zone
findings.observation: The plan puts a bathroom wall directly against the kitchen wall. In form-school Feng Shui and in Vastu Shastra alike, the water room and the cooking zone are read as belonging to separate parts of the home.
On this stack the bathroom footprint sits directly above the kitchen footprint. In Vastu Shastra the cooking zone is read as sitting best with nothing of the water zone above it.
The bathroom door opens onto the kitchen area rather than onto a hall. In form-school Feng Shui a water-room door facing the cooking zone is read as letting the two zones mix.

findings.principle: Bathroom Door onto the Dining Area
findings.observation: The bathroom door opens onto the dining area. In form-school Feng Shui the tradition prefers a hall or a lobby between the water room and the place where a household eats.
The entry door lines up with the rear opening across an unbroken run of the unit. In form-school Feng Shui this straight line is read as letting arriving chi pass through rather than settle.

The plan shows a toilet on the far side of the wall the bed head would sit against. Both Feng Shui and Vastu Shastra read the head-of-bed wall as a wall the tradition prefers to keep away from plumbing.
A structural core sits at the centre of the drawn unit boundary. In Vastu Shastra the Brahmasthan at the centre of a home is the part the tradition keeps open.
The kitchen sits immediately inside the entry. In Vastu Shastra the cooking zone is read as belonging to the south-east of the home rather than to the threshold.

findings.principle: Wall Options for the Bed Head
findings.observation: The bedroom offers two solid walls for the head of the bed that are clear of the door line. Both Feng Shui and Vastu Shastra read a solid, supported headboard wall as the placement to look for.

suggestions.title: Layer the entry threshold
suggestions.detail: A rug, a low console, and a plant just inside the door give an arriving line of movement somewhere to settle before it reaches the rear of the unit.

suggestions.title: Keep the water-room door closed
suggestions.detail: A self-closing hinge or a simple door stop keeps the bathroom door shut toward the kitchen and dining side, which is the remedy both traditions describe.

suggestions.title: Choose the supported bed wall
suggestions.detail: Place the bed head against the solid wall that is clear of the door line and of the bathroom plumbing, and use a solid headboard.

suggestions.title: Keep the centre of the home open
suggestions.detail: Leave the middle of the unit free of tall or heavy furniture, with light rugs and low pieces, so the centre reads as open in Vastu terms.
